name: How long does window flashing repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does window flashing repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of window flashing repair depends on the number of windows requiring service and the complexity of the damage. A single window with minor flashing issues might take a few hours, while multiple windows or those with significant underlying damage could extend to a full day or more. We aim to complete projects efficiently while maintaining high standards of quality. Our team will provide a clear timeline estimate after evaluating the scope of work at your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for one window to a day or more for multiple windows or extensive damage.
